name: Raden Saleh in Europe
summary: A young Javanese aristocrat with a gift for drawing sails for the Netherlands in 1829 and stays more than twenty years. He studies painting in The Hague, lives at the court of Dresden, travels with Horace Vernet to French Algeria, and becomes the first modern painter from Southeast Asia known in Europe before he returns to Java.

stops.note: Ten years of study under Dutch painters.
Friend of dukes and poets at the Saxon court.
South to the sea with Vernet.
In French Algeria, which he paints for years after.
At the end of 1851 he takes ship for home.
Home after more than twenty years.
